The twins' little adventures about courage, sharing, and loving Allah. Pick one and read it together at bedtime.

✨ New on the shelf

👶 ages 4–8The Gift from Isra Mi'raj

📖 16 pages · ⏱ 4 min

"Praying again? Five times a day is so many!" Mo grumbles. Then Abi tells him about the most amazing night journey — and it turns out prayer wasn't five times at first, but FIFTY!

👶 ages 4–8The Ashura Fast and the Parted Sea

📖 16 pages · ⏱ 4 min

At the beach, a wave knocks down Mo's sandcastle. "The sea is so strong!" Then Abi tells the story of the sea that parted and the day Prophet Musa was saved — the day of Ashura.

👶 ages 4–8The Twins' Hijri New Year

📖 16 pages · ⏱ 4 min

"Another New Year? Isn't New Year in January?" Mo is puzzled by the torch parade. It turns out there's a calendar that follows the moon, and it begins with a great journey: the Hijrah!

👶 ages 4–8Grandpa Goes on Hajj

📖 16 pages · ⏱ 4 min

Grandpa is off to Makkah for Hajj! From home, the twins follow his journey step by step — ihram, tawaf, sa'i, standing at Arafah — until Grandpa comes home with zamzam water.

👶 ages 4–8The Twins' Qurban Goat

📖 16 pages · ⏱ 4 min

A week before Eid al-Adha, a white goat arrives in the garden. Mo names him Si Embek and loves him straight away. But Si Embek is the qurban goat…

👶 ages 4–8Ais's Syawal Stars

📖 16 pages · ⏱ 4 min

Eid was only three days ago and the nastar jar is still full… but Ais is fasting again! What is the Syawal fast? And why is fasting alone so much harder?

👶 ages 4–8Ketupat for the New Neighbours

📖 16 pages · ⏱ 4 min

Umi cooks a huge pot of opor — some of it for the neighbours. There are new neighbours at the end of the road: Tante Maria and Kevin. Can they share the Eid food too?

👶 ages 4–8The Twins' Eid Morning

📖 16 pages · ⏱ 4 min

The takbir wakes the twins. It's Eid! There are dates to count in odd numbers, seven takbirs that make Mo lose count, and… a mixed-up pair of sandals!
